detail.question: Quelles categories de produits ont le panier moyen le plus eleve, avec leur nom en anglais ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH ca_par_categorie AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_category_name,
    SUM(oi.price) AS chiffre_affaires_total,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS nombre_de_commandes
  FROM
    entrepot."order_items" oi
  JOIN
    entrepot."products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY
    p.product_category_name
),
panier_moyen AS (
  SELECT
    product_category_name,
    chiffre_affaires_total,
    nombre_de_commandes,
    chiffre_affaires_total / nombre_de_commandes AS panier_moyen
  FROM
    ca_par_categorie
)
SELECT
  pm.product_category_name,
  pct.product_category_name_english AS "nom_en_anglais",
  pm.chiffre_affaires_total AS "chiffre_affaires_total",
  pm.nombre_de_commandes AS "nombre_de_commandes",
  pm.panier_moyen AS "panier_moyen"
FROM
  panier_moyen pm
JOIN
  entrepot."product_category_name_translation" pct ON pm.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
ORDER BY
  pm.panier_moyen DESC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Les vendeurs de quels etats livrent le plus vite ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH temps_livraison AS (
  SELECT
    s.seller_state AS etat_vendeur,
    o.order_approved_at,
    o.order_delivered_customer_date,
    TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) - TRY_CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS temps_livraison_jours
  FROM entrepot.orders o
  JOIN entrepot.sellers s ON o.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
  etat_vendeur,
  AVG(temps_livraison_jours) AS temps_moyen_livraison_jours,
  COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes
FROM temps_livraison
GROUP BY etat_vendeur
ORDER BY temps_moyen_livraison_jours ASC
LIMIT 1000

detail.question: Quelle est la note moyenne par categorie de produit, en anglais, pour les categories evaluees au moins cinq cents fois ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
  category.product_category_name_english AS "Categorie de produit",
  AVG(reviews.review_score) AS "Note moyenne"
FROM
  entrepot."order_reviews" AS reviews
  JOIN entrepot."orders" AS orders ON reviews.order_id = orders.order_id
  JOIN entrepot."order_items" AS items ON orders.order_id = items.order_id
  JOIN entrepot."products" AS products ON items.product_id = products.product_id
  JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" AS category ON products.product_category_name = category.product_category_name
GROUP BY
  category.product_category_name_english
HAVING
  COUNT(reviews.review_id) >= 500
ORDER BY
  "Note moyenne" DESC
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Les commentaires des clients mecontents sont-ils plus longs que ceux des clients satisfaits ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH reviews AS (
  SELECT
    review_score,
    LENGTH(review_comment_message) AS comment_length
  FROM
    entrepot."order_reviews"
  WHERE
    review_comment_message IS NOT NULL
    AND review_comment_message != ''
)

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN review_score IN (1, 2) THEN 'Insatisfait'
    WHEN review_score IN (4, 5) THEN 'Satisfait'
    ELSE 'Autre'
  END AS satisfaction,
  AVG(comment_length) AS longueur_moyenne_commentaire,
  COUNT(*) AS nombre_commentaires
FROM
  reviews
GROUP BY
  satisfaction
ORDER BY
  satisfaction;

detail.question: Le chiffre d'affaires du second semestre 2017 est-il superieur a celui du premier ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH ca_2017 AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(price) AS chiffre_affaires,
    CASE
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-06-30' THEN 'Premier semestre'
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2017-07-01' AND '2017-12-31' THEN 'Second semestre'
    END AS semestre
  FROM
    entrepot."order_items"
  JOIN
    entrepot."orders" ON entrepot."order_items".order_id = entrepot."orders".order_id
  WHERE
    TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
)

SELECT
  semestre,
  chiffre_affaires,
  CASE
    WHEN semestre = 'Second semestre' AND chiffre_affaires > (SELECT chiffre_affaires FROM ca_2017 WHERE semestre = 'Premier semestre') THEN 'Oui'
    WHEN semestre = 'Second semestre' THEN 'Non'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS est_superieur
FROM
  ca_2017
ORDER BY
  semestre

detail.question: La note moyenne s'est-elle amelioree entre 2017 et 2018 ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH notes_par_annee AS (
  SELECT
    TRY_CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS INTEGER) AS annee,
    AVG(review_score) AS note_moyenne
  FROM entrepot."order_reviews"
  JOIN entrepot."orders" ON entrepot."order_reviews".order_id = entrepot."orders".order_id
  WHERE TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-12-31'
  GROUP BY annee
)

SELECT
  annee,
  note_moyenne,
  LAG(note_moyenne) OVER (ORDER BY annee) AS note_moyenne_precedente,
  note_moyenne - LAG(note_moyenne) OVER (ORDER BY annee) AS difference
FROM notes_par_annee
ORDER BY annee

detail.question: Quel trimestre de 2018 a le mieux marche en volume ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN TRY_CAST(entrepot."orders".order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-03-31' THEN 'T1'
    WHEN TRY_CAST(entrepot."orders".order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-04-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-06-30' THEN 'T2'
    WHEN TRY_CAST(entrepot."orders".order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-09-30' THEN 'T3'
    WHEN TRY_CAST(entrepot."orders".order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-10-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-12-31' THEN 'T4'
  END AS trimestre,
  COUNT(DISTINCT entrepot."orders".order_id) AS nombre_de_commandes
FROM
  entrepot."orders"
WHERE
  entrepot."orders".order_status = 'delivered'
  AND TRY_CAST(entrepot."orders".order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-12-31'
GROUP BY
  trimestre
ORDER BY
  nombre_de_commandes DESC
LIMIT 1
